mode.description: exact = same look and layout; editable = reflowed, easy to edit.

ocr.description: Recognise text on scanned pages and images when the target holds text.

dpi.description: Page images (PDF to PNG/JPEG) and SVG rasterising.

paper.description: Page size for HTML and TXT printed to PDF.

notesPages.description: PowerPoint to PDF: add a notes page after each slide.

pdfaEmbedSource.description: PDF/A-3b: attach the source file inside the PDF.

keepPdfaId.description: PDF/A to PDF: copy the file unchanged (it still says it is PDF/A).

merge.description: Also merge all converted files into one.

verifyAppearance.description: Exact mode: render both files and compare the pages.

txtSplitTabs.description: TXT to XLSX: split each line into cells at tabs.
